Class UserRegister

java.lang.Object
UserRegister
public class UserRegister extends Object
Registry class for managing users in the diary application.

Responsibility
This class is responsible for managing a collection of User objects. It handles user registration, authentication (login), looking upp users, and persistence (saving/lading users to/from JSON files). The class also provides password hashing functionality to ensure passwords are stored securely.

UserRegister acts as the single point of access for all user-related operations within the system.

Information stored and datatype choices:
- userList (ArrayList<User>): A dynamic list for all registrerd users. ArrayList was chosen because:
- The number of users is unknown when starting the program, and will grow as new users is added
- Users needs to be iterated through for login verification and looking upp users
- ArrayList provides access by index and efficient iteration with streams.
- Easy serialisation/deserialisation with the Gson libary
- gson (Gson): A Gson instance for JSON serialisation. Gson was chosen because:
- It handles complex object serialisation authomatically.
- It is a widely used and well documented libary for JSON in java.
- Supports generic types like ArrayList<User>
